subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a misspelt word.

A __piano__ teacher described an __interesting encountar__ she had with a young lady who came to __inquire__ about music lessons.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **encountar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"encountar"** is misspelt and should be **"encounter"**.
 
• **"Encounter"** refers to an unexpected or casual meeting with someone or something. (मुठभेड़)
 
 
• **Example: **She had a brief encounter with a famous actor at the airport.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **encountar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interesting **(दिलचस्प): Arousing curiosity or interest; holding or catching the attention.

 
 
• **Example:** The movie was so interesting that I didn't want it to end.
 
 
 
• **Inquire **(पूछना): Ask for information from someone.
 
 
• **Example: **He called the office to inquire about the job opening.
 
 
 
• **Piano** (पियानो): A large keyboard musical instrument with a wooden case enclosing a soundboard and metal strings.
 
 
• **Example:** She has been learning to play the piano for five years.
